query: Can an employee carry forward unused annual leave to the next year?

**Policy rule – Timing of annual leave**  
- Employees are required to take their annual leave in the calendar year in which the entitlement arises. [Source: LAW040] (Article 109).

**Exception – Postponement of leave**  
- An employer may postpone the employee’s annual leave for up to **90 days** after the entitlement year when business circumstances justify it. [Source: LAW045] (Article 110).  
- A **further postponement** is possible only if the employee gives **written consent**, and the postponed leave **cannot extend beyond the end of the following year**. [Source: LAW045] (Article 110).
